channels_monitored_only_when_active.name: channels_monitored_only_when_active
channels_monitored_only_when_active.value: NOT "channels"."monitored" OR ("channels"."connection_status" = 'active' AND "channels"."authorization_ack_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."monitoring_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."visible_indicator_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND ("channels"."provider" <> 'telegram' OR ("channels"."provider_chat_type" IN ('group','supergroup')) IS TRUE))

notifications_source_valid.name: notifications_source_valid
notifications_source_valid.value: "notifications"."label_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("notifications"."kind" IN ('reminder','escalation') AND "notifications"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL)

notifications_not_sent_and_cancelled.name: notifications_not_sent_and_cancelled
notifications_not_sent_and_cancelled.value: NOT ("notifications"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

identities_identifier_required.name: identities_identifier_required
identities_identifier_required.value: "person_identities"."external_id" IS NOT NULL OR "person_identities"."handle" IS NOT NULL

threads_closure_matches_status.name: threads_closure_matches_status
threads_closure_matches_status.value: ("threads"."status" IN ('tentative','active')) = ("threads"."closed_at" IS NULL) AND ("threads"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("threads"."closure_kind" IS NULL)

threads_reason_length.name: threads_reason_length
threads_reason_length.value: "threads"."closure_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("threads"."closure_reason") BETWEEN 5 AND 300

wsdb_ack_before_connection.name: wsdb_ack_before_connection
wsdb_ack_before_connection.value: "workspace_databases"."url_secret_ref" IS NULL OR "workspace_databases"."availability_ack_at" IS NOT NULL

wsdb_status_matches_state.name: wsdb_status_matches_state
wsdb_status_matches_state.value: ("workspace_databases"."status" = 'pending') = ("workspace_databases"."url_secret_ref" IS NULL) AND ("workspace_databases"."status" = 'unreachable') = ("workspace_databases"."unreachable_since" IS NOT NULL)
